crossRefs.note: So the steward took away their dainties, and the wine that they would drink, and gave them vegetables.

people.name: Azariah
people.line: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.

people.name: Melzar
people.line: Babylonian official in charge of Daniel and his friends.

people.name: Mishael
people.line: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.

translations.web: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
translations.bsb: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the chief official had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
translations.kjv: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
translations.asv: Then said Daniel to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
